stroke_matching.value: match_strokes: each GT and predicted stroke is rendered as a mask of thickness 5 px on the canvas; one-to-one Hungarian assignment maximising mask IoU; pairs with IoU < 0.5 are discarded. Used by strict order, Kendall tau and direction.

strict_order.value: strict_order_acc = 1 iff n_pred == n_gt and every GT stroke is matched and the matched predicted indices are strictly increasing in GT order; else 0 (per unit).

kendall_tau.value: scipy kendalltau (tau-b) between GT stroke indices and matched predicted stroke indices; defined only with at least 2 matched strokes, else NaN (also NaN if not finite). tau_cp in the tables = units with at least 2 GT strokes, undefined tau set to 0.

direction.value: direction_acc = share of matched strokes with GT start-to-end chord >= 2.0 px whose predicted first point is nearer to the GT first point than to the GT last point; NaN when no matched stroke is eligible.

penup_f1_v2.value: penup_endpoint_f1(gt, pr, tau=3.0): cost between a GT and a predicted stroke = min over the two orientations of the larger of the two end-point distances; Hungarian assignment on this cost; TP = assigned pairs with cost <= 3.0 px; F1 = 2 TP / (n_gt + n_pred); 0 if either side has no stroke. Invariant to stroke order and stroke direction.

aiou.value: adaptive_iou (Nagamatsu metrics.py, unchanged): GT rendered with thickness 2, prediction with thickness 1 on the 64x64 canvas; the prediction mask is dilated with a 3x3 kernel 0 to 4 times and the maximum IoU over the 5 masks is returned (score() defaults aiou_gt_thickness=2, aiou_max_dilation=4).

protocol.value: native protocol: metrics on the stored points; standardised protocol resamples both sides at step 1.0 px first; tables use native.
